Name: Rainko's Seasonal Mailboxes
Author: rainko1
Description:
如何安装：Stardew Valley\Mods


这是我第一次制作MOD，所以如果有发现错误请留言并附上你的 https://smapi.io/log 文件，我会尽量修复。
如果你同时有在使用其它包含邮箱的美化mod，请在其配置菜单里关掉邮箱的选项，这样就可以正常显示本mod。
This is my first time making a mod, so if you find a bug, please leave a comment and attach your https://smapi.io/log file, I will try to fix it.
If you are using other beautification mods that include mailboxes, please turn off the mailbox option in their config menu so that this mod can be displayed normally.

Manifest.Name: Rainko's Seasonal Mailboxes
Manifest.Description: cute mailboxes of vanilla style will change with the seasons and festivals.
Manifest.Author: Rainko
